# vendor/gltf

Lab asset drop for Bancada / GNU Atelier.

- Put **`.glb`** here (binary glTF 2.0). Keep each file small.
- Pipeline: [`docs/ATELIER-GLTF-PIPELINE.md`](../../../docs/ATELIER-GLTF-PIPELINE.md)
- Classic Three only. No R3F. No unpkg.
- Filename should match a CID or a stable `object_id` slug — do not put secrets in names.
- Land parcels do not live here as movable meshes.

Empty until an operator drops a model. `.gitkeep` holds the directory.
